verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer documents a dedicated data privacy practice. The firm claims more CIPPs than comparable firms, extensive drafting of privacy policies and negotiation of privacy and security contract terms, and a large team covering data privacy for emerging companies. That is direct evidence of a privacy practice, but the pack never names GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or local-regime compliance counseling, and it does not describe a cybersecurity or incident-response practice. Missing for 10: explicit GDPR/CCPA/DPDP or equivalent regulatory compliance counseling, a documented cyber/breach-response practice, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: we have more CIPPs (Certified Information Privacy Professionals) than any other comparable firm
We've created more privacy policies and negotiated more privacy and security-related contractual provisions for emerging companies than any other firm.
With the largest team in the world focused on licensing, strategic partnering, commercial transactions, and data privacy for emerging company/venture capital (EC/VC) companies and funds
